fields: L5 Shanghai / Dragon Boat Festival (e-bike; Lujiazui → the Bund → Huaihai Road → Xintiandi). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 端午摊 Zongzi Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Xintiandi-entrance final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Xintiandi final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 端午谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L4 banks (all grades).

questions.q_zh: 这条街上有 80 个摊位门口，其中 3/5 挂了艾草，有多少家挂了艾草？

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: A shikumen is a ____.
questions.q_zh: 石库门是____。
questions.explain_en: It is a stone-gated Shanghai house.
questions.explain_zh: 石库门是有石门框的里弄房子。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海生活（梧桐/黄浦江/石库门）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: There are 18 stall doors on the street, and 1/2 of them have mugwort hung up. How many doors have mugwort?
questions.q_zh: 这条街上有 18 个摊位门口，其中 1/2 挂了艾草，有多少家挂了艾草？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: An e-bike rental costs C = 4 + 8k yuan for k km. What is C when k = 12?
questions.q_zh: 租电动车的价钱是 C = 4 + 8k 元（k 为千米数），k = 12 时 C 是多少？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: There are 30 stall doors on the street, and 1/2 of them have mugwort hung up. How many doors have mugwort?
questions.q_zh: 这条街上有 30 个摊位门口，其中 1/2 挂了艾草，有多少家挂了艾草？

questions.subject: riddle
questions.q_en: Festival riddle: I am the warm white puff you see when a fresh zongzi is unwrapped. What am I?
questions.q_zh: 端午谜：刚打开一只热粽子时，你看见我这一团暖暖的白气。打一物，是什么？
questions.explain_en: Hot food gives off steam, which is water as a gas.
questions.explain_zh: 热食物冒出的白气是水蒸气。

questions.subject: shanghai
questions.q_en: Riding from Lujiazui to the Bund, Flora crosses to the other side of the Huangpu in the story's scene change. Which pair is correct?
questions.q_zh: 故事里 Flora 从陆家嘴来到外滩，是到了黄浦江的另一边。下面哪一对是对的？
choices: Both are in a desert oasis
Lujiazui is in Pudong; the Bund is in Puxi
Both sit on a high mountain pass
The Bund is in Pudong; Lujiazui is a village abroad
choices_zh: 陆家嘴在浦东，外滩在浦西
外滩在浦东，陆家嘴在国外村子
questions.explain_en: Lujiazui is a Pudong area; the Bund is on the Puxi waterfront.
questions.explain_zh: 陆家嘴在浦东，外滩在浦西滨江。
questions.qtype_zh: 上海生活（梧桐/黄浦江/石库门）

questions.subject: duanwu
questions.q_en: From the Bund, Flora watches a dragon boat: one person beats a drum and the paddles move together. That person is the ____.
questions.q_zh: Flora 在外滩看龙舟：有一个人敲鼓，船上的桨就一起动。那个人是____。
questions.explain_en: The drummer sets the stroke for the crew.
questions.explain_zh: 鼓手给全船定划桨节奏。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: From the foot of a flag pole on the Bund, a rope runs to a point 12 m along the deck; the pole is 5 m tall. How long is the rope from the top of the pole, in metres?
questions.q_zh: 外滩一根旗杆高 5 米，从杆顶拉一根绳子到地面离杆脚 12 米的地方，绳长多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A cylindrical festival drum on the Bund has radius 2 dm and height 30 dm. Using π ≈ 3.14, what is its volume in dm³?
questions.q_zh: 外滩一面圆柱形节日鼓底面半径 2 分米、高 30 分米，π 取 3.14，体积是多少立方分米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A sketch of the Xintiandi doorway is 5 cm wide and 8 cm tall. A similar banner copy is 20 cm wide. How tall is the banner in cm?
questions.q_zh: 新天地门口的草图宽 5 厘米、高 8 厘米，放大成相似的横幅后宽 20 厘米，高是多少厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Zongzi are set out at Xintiandi following L = 5 + 2n, where n is minutes after the doors open. How many zongzi are out when n = 10?
questions.q_zh: 新天地的粽子按 L = 5 + 2n 摆出，n 是开门后的分钟数。n = 10 时摆出了多少只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a Shanghai map, 1 cm stands for 500 m. The path from the Bund to Xintiandi is 4 cm on the map. How many metres is it really?
questions.q_zh: 上海地图上 1 厘米代表 500 米，从外滩到新天地的路在图上长 4 厘米，实际是多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A round festival drum on the Bund has a diameter of 50 cm. Using π ≈ 3.14, how many cm of ribbon go once around it?
questions.q_zh: 外滩一面节日圆鼓直径 50 厘米，π 取 3.14，绕它一圈的彩带要多少厘米？
